exposure: prolonged active second stage of labour
Prolonged active second stage of labour
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Incidence of levator ani muscle (LAM) avulsion
cohort: Nulliparous women at 36 weeks of gestation
finding: The incidence of LAM avulsion following vaginal delivery was 21%, with obstetric anal sphincter injuries, prolonged active second stage of labour, and forceps delivery identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: No LAM avulsion was found after caesarean section.
